name: Platform Forge
summary: Platform engineering specialist: IDP posture, golden paths, Kubernetes, GitOps, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), IaC, observability, SRE, service catalog and secrets scanning. Exposes nine analyze_* seams plus a native capability manifest.
appropriate_for: repository/platform posture: GHA workflows, k8s manifests, IaC, GitOps state, service catalog
secrets scanning of a repo tree (with the staging boundary — see limitations)
inappropriate_for: Spark or cloud-data engineering — route to the spark-engineering family
API contract design — route to api-forge
verifying its own output — use an independent doctor

install.command: python3.11 -m venv <platform-venv> && <platform-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <platform-python> -m pip install "platformforge>=0.1,<0.2" <the-forge>/adapters/platformforge

limitations_note: secrets.scan only sees what the core stages: secret-bearing inputs (.env and friends) are excluded by staging with reason 'secret' before the specialist runs — a 0-facts result means the boundary held, not that the repo is clean.
examples: analyze this repo's GitHub Actions posture
scan the staged tree for secrets
evaluate the service catalog coverage of a platform
